summary: TSMC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its September 2026 monthly revenue report and standard operational disclosures on lending, guarantees, and derivatives. Consolidated September net revenue was NT$511.86 billion, down 0.6% month-over-month but up 54.6% year-over-year, while January-September revenue reached NT$3,898.73 billion, up 41.1% versus the prior-year period. Ancillary items included intercompany loans to TSMC Washington, guarantees for TSMC North America, TSMC Global, and TSMC Arizona, plus mark-to-market data on outstanding forward contracts. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or transaction mechanics are stated; the filing carries no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
